description: c-saves: Rust-native world storage engine for Paper 26.3. CRS2 container: CSEC-v3/v4 section codec (v4 0xC8 adds a third flag byte: uniform light forms — all-0 BlockLight, all-0/all-1 SkyLight — collapsing the underground 2048-byte light arrays to flag bits) (compound palettes, vanilla 4-bit width clamp, frequency-canonical order, dense bit-packing), v0.6.0 SIZE: content-deterministic section RLE forms — the canonical voxel stream is additionally encoded as [idx u8][varint run] pairs in vanilla order (collapses horizontal strata planes) and in y-fast transposed order (collapses columns/vertical walls); the smallest of dense/RLE/RLE-transposed wins, so extreme-height JJThunder-style terrain sections collapse to a few dozen bytes while noisy sections keep the dense stream (dedup hashes stay content-pure), delta-varint heightmaps, per-key field split for entity/POI payloads, content-addressed section dedup with canonical permutation-invariant hashes, chunk-locality-ordered slab packing (mode-aware dictionary), id/varint recipes, versioned shared zstd dictionaries, hot/cold two-tier compression (hot=3: 2.1x faster writes at identical packed size) with auto-pack watermark, transparent Moonrise chunk-IO takeover, Anvil import/export. v0.5.0 SPEED: fused CSEC-to-NBT emitter, batched single-pass section loads, per-thread emit/encode caches, one-pass dense<->no-straddle converters, O(1) recipe-batch index, lock-free segment mmaps. 4 MiB section slabs (longer zstd windows). Real JJThunder corpus verified every push (bad=0 CI gate). v0.9.0: light-uniform codec + bigworld pack-drain fix (re-request pack per compact step — the old wave loop stopped after one segment and left 2 GB of z3 hot blobs unpacked) + streaming integrity scan with self-heal re-import + fixed palette attribution (fastnbt to_bytes needs a compound root; bare lists measured 0). v0.9.2 INTEGRITY: root-cause fix for silent chunk loss — gc_dicts deleted dictionary FILES that recipes' inline tails (Tail::Inline, tail < tail_blob_min) still referenced (blob-only accounting cannot see recipe references); dict files are now immutable (RAM map is a pure cache, decompress lazy-loads from disk, read->write self-deadlock in the reload path fixed), bigworld integrity scan gained per-key forensics (read_fail_reason names the first blocking stage) and a bounded-drain guard; regression test reproduces the loss via dead-ratio drop_seg compaction. v0.9.3: writer-segment ROLL fix - append() seeked to `written` instead of `written - buf.len()` while the append buffer still held unflushed records, zeroing the segment tail (batch recipes decoded rawlen=0, blobs decompressed to garbage) and the full-rewrite pack then dropped those blobs, dangling every recipe that referenced them (23,380 of 261,572 chunks unreadable on the 262k-chunk bigworld; JJ-corpus benches never roll a segment with a non-empty buffer, so they stayed clean). Roll now seeks to written - buf.len(); Cfg.seg_roll (CSAVES_SEG_ROLL); pack drop path is poison-guarded (unreadable victims keep the segment, never re-packed, loud logs); regression test forces non-empty-buffer rolls. v0.9.4: GLOB form ON by default - the 0xCB global state registry (jj_exp5 entropy winner, x2.16 on vanilla-terrain dense streams) is now the natural pack choice: sections convert to 1-byte global-id streams, slab stores whichever of canonical/glob compresses smaller, reads convert back to canonical CSEC. ROOT-CAUSE FIX for the former natural-choice corruption (JJ corpus verify bad=32): glob_to_section rebuilt target palettes in count-ASCENDING order while the canonical encoder is count-DESCENDING, so 0xC9 shift-ref members (which store their top planes as TARGET-CANONICAL palette indices computed at write time) decoded with rotated palettes against glob-rebuilt targets - andesite appeared at palette index 0, 32 chunks wrong. The rebuild now reproduces the exact enc_pal_data_canon rule (count DESC, ties (plain,name,props) ASC), making glob roundtrips byte-identical for encoder-produced sections; regression test glob_rebuild_keeps_shiftref_target_order fails on pre-fix code. New Store::slab_invariant_scan diagnostic cross-checks the blob map against on-disk slab entry tables; probe_glob/probe_bad2 examples document the hunt. CSAVES_GLOB=0 opts out.
